title: Quantum-to-Quantum Transfer Learning Exhibits Improved Robustness in Low-Data Regimes
abstract: arXiv:2605.09118v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transfer learning under limited data is a challenging setting, where models must adapt to new tasks with minimal supervision. Prior work has primarily focused on improving absolute accuracy in transfer learning. However, empirical evidence comparing quantum and classical models in realistic transfer learning settings remains limited, especially in low-data regimes. In this work, we systematically study the robustness of quantum models under reduced training data. We evaluate multiple quantum and classical architectures across diverse transfer tasks and retraining configurations, and quantify robustness using accuracy degradation and relative performance retention (RPR). Our results show that, although classical models often achieve higher peak performance, they exhibit significantly larger degradation when training data is limited. translated_title: 量子到量子迁移学习在低数据情况下展现出更强的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 在数据受限条件下的迁移学习是一个具有挑战性的场景，模型必须在极少监督的情况下适应新任务。以往的工作主要集中于提高迁移学习的绝对准确率。然而，在现实的迁移学习场景中对量子模型和经典模型进行比较的实证证据仍然有限，尤其是在低数据情况下。在这项工作中，我们系统地研究了量子模型在训练数据减少情况下的鲁棒性。我们在多样化的迁移任务和再训练配置下评估了多种量子与经典架构，并使用准确率下降幅度和相对性能保留率（RPR）来量化鲁棒性。我们的结果表明，尽管经典模型通常能达到更高的峰值性能，但当训练数据受限时，其性能下降幅度显著更大。相比之下，量子模型在不同数据规模下能保持更稳定的性能，这表明其……
tldr: 该论文系统评估了多种量子与经典模型在迁移学习任务中的表现，发现尽管经典模型峰值性能更高，但量子模型在训练数据受限时性能下降显著更小，展现出更强的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates quantum and classical models across transfer learning tasks, finding that although classical models achieve higher peak performance, quantum models exhibit significantly smaller performance degradation under limited training data, demonstrating superior robustness in low-data regimes.
